subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Screen Reader Testing
description: A quick win: understand Screen Reader Testing.

hook.text: A developer tests with NVDA for the first time. The screen reader announces element after element of gibberish.

buildup.text: Screen readers convert visual content to speech. They rely on HTML semantics, ARIA, and document structure.

discovery.text: Testing with screen readers checks heading hierarchy, form labels, link text, and dynamic content updates.

twist.text: NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver behave differently. A fix for one may not work for another.

climax.text: Testing with all three major screen readers catches issues that any single reader would have missed.

punchline.text: Listen to your app. What the reader announces is the user experience.

quiz.question: Why test with multiple screen readers?
options: Each interprets markup differently and reveals unique issues
